_meta.purpose: Seed data for future mapping into the app's Component object (lib/types.ts). Not wired into lib/mock/data.ts or any app code. Research-only, per issue #4.
_meta.note: geographySignal reflects where this research found part-type-specific evidence, per README.md's 'US vs AU asymmetry' guardrail. It is not a claim that AU demand does not exist -- only that AU-specific evidence for this exact part type was not found in this research pass.

components.name: Actuator Housing
components.description: Custom protective/structural housing for linear or rotary actuators in robotic and automation systems, including bearing interfaces and ball-screw bores.
components.typicalToleranceNote: Vendor-stated ranges cluster around +/-0.02mm dimensional / +/-0.01mm hole position for general features, tightening toward high-precision claims on critical bores; vendor-stated, not independently audited.

evidence.summary: Actuator-housing product line explicitly scoped to semiconductor/robotics automation.
Actuator-housing product line explicitly scoped to Robotics & Automation, with multiple US-city-localized landing pages.

components.name: Joint Housing (Harmonic Drive / Gearbox)
components.description: Precision housing for robot-arm joints containing a harmonic drive or gearbox, maintaining preload/clamping force on the drive interface.
components.typicalToleranceNote: No single numeric tolerance independently verified; vendor content emphasizes precision as 'non-negotiable' for backlash control, without a specific published figure in the sources found.

evidence.summary: Technical explainer on machining harmonic-drive housings for humanoid joints: 7075-T7351 chosen for creep resistance, 5-axis toolpaths used to limit thermal input and preserve clamping force.
5-axis CNC machining specifically discussed for high-load, high-precision robotic arm joints.

components.name: Gripper Jaw / Finger
components.description: Custom-machined gripper jaw, finger, or drive/coupling component for robotic end effectors, requiring precision grip-surface and pivot-bore tolerance.
components.typicalToleranceNote: One vendor states +/-0.001in general features, +/-0.0005in on critical grip surfaces and pivot bores; single-source, not corroborated.

evidence.summary: Gripper jaw/finger/drive/coupling components machined for US robotics teams from aluminum, steel, and Delrin.
Custom gripper parts use 6061-T6/7075-T6 aluminum, wire EDM and precision contouring; stated tolerances +/-0.001in general, +/-0.0005in critical.

components.name: EOAT / End-Effector Plate
components.description: End-of-arm-tooling plate or custom tool mounted at a robot's wrist for pick-and-place, palletizing, grinding, or assembly tasks.
components.typicalToleranceNote: Not independently found; process choice (machining vs. 3D printing) is explicitly framed as turnaround/cost driven rather than tolerance-driven in the sources found.

evidence.summary: Custom EOAT for palletizing, pick and place, grinding, and assembly applications.
3D printing marketed as faster/cheaper/more flexible than traditional manufacturing specifically for custom, short-run EOAT.
Secondary price-guide source: entry-level EOAT ~$200-$1,000, mid-range ~$1,000-$3,000.

components.name: Sensor / Camera Mount
components.description: Vibration-isolating, precisely aligned bracket for mounting machine-vision cameras, encoders, LiDAR, or force sensors on or near a robot.
components.typicalToleranceNote: Sources cite figures ranging from +/-0.02mm (camera mounting) to +/-0.0005in (critical features on encoder/LiDAR/camera brackets) from different vendors -- not the same claim, see actuator/sensor files for detail.

evidence.summary: Robotic vision camera bracket designed to minimize transmission of dynamic vibration/shock and preserve focal stability.
Encoder brackets, LiDAR mounts, camera brackets, and force sensor flanges named as a standing product line for robotics.
2026-dated integration guide discussing metal 3D printing as a real alternative process for custom sensor brackets.

components.name: Motor Mount / Base Plate
components.description: Precision mounting plate for electric/servo motors and gearboxes, designed for alignment accuracy and low vibration.
components.typicalToleranceNote: Not independently found in sources for this specific part type.

evidence.summary: Motor mount base plates deliver accurate alignment and low vibration; common materials aluminum 6061/7075, carbon steel, stainless steel, engineering plastics.

components.name: Adapter / Base Plate (Robot-to-Tool)
components.description: Plate bridging a specific robot arm's wrist-flange bolt pattern to a specific tool, gripper, or accessory bolt pattern.
components.typicalToleranceNote: Not independently found; the defining engineering constraint is bolt-pattern matching, not a general dimensional tolerance.

evidence.summary: Adapter plate line requires customers to specify their robot's make and model plus intended equipment for a matched bolt pattern.
Dedicated cobot-specific mounting-adapter product line.

components.name: Structural Bracket / Enclosure
components.description: Custom sheet-metal enclosure or structural bracket for housing controllers/power distribution/comms in a robot cell, or providing safety perimeter guarding, typically to a stated IP rating.
components.typicalToleranceNote: No numeric tolerance found; IP rating (e.g. IP65, IP54+) is the dominant stated spec rather than a dimensional tolerance.

evidence.summary: Custom sheet-metal enclosures for industrial automation, housing controllers/PDUs/comms modules.
Dedicated safety-enclosure product line for robot cells.
IP65/IP54+ ratings and custom exact-fit/grounding-path benefits stated for industrial automation enclosures.

components.name: Jig / Fixture / Inspection Fixture
components.description: Custom machining, welding, assembly, check, or CMM-inspection fixture, often built as part of a turnkey tooling system for a production line or robot cell.
components.typicalToleranceNote: One aggregated source cites +/-0.005mm with 3-week delivery for custom CNC/welding/inspection fixtures; blended-source attribution, see README.md limitation 3a.

evidence.summary: Jig & fixture manufacturer offering check fixtures, welding fixtures, turnkey fixtures, and jig services with free quotes.
Design and implementation of cobot inspection and assembly cells with tailored custom tooling.
5-Axis CNC and metrology, design/build/inspection done in-house for automotive, aerospace, heavy equipment, military, alt-energy.

components.name: General Custom CNC / Sheet-Metal Part
components.description: Catch-all for custom CNC-machined or sheet-metal parts sourced through generalist instant-quote marketplaces rather than a robotics-specific product line -- the competitive surface every other component above must also compete within.
components.typicalToleranceNote: Marketplace-stated ranges vary by vendor; Hubs/Protolabs Network states tolerances to +/-0.0008in, Precision Manufacturing Australia states +/-0.01mm -- both vendor-stated, not independently audited.

evidence.summary: Xometry robotics-specific vertical page and generalist CNC/sheet-metal instant-quote service.
Xometry operates a dedicated Australia & New Zealand storefront.
Precision Manufacturing Australia instant online quotes, +/-0.01mm tolerance claim, small batch to 100K+ units.
